description: Calculation, not advice. Verify with a professional before acting. Standard compound interest calculator. Returns future value, total contributions, interest earned, effective annual rate, and milestones. Pick this for a balance that grows with contributions. Pick `calculate_opportunity_cost` when the money is recurring spending being priced against investing, and `calculate_loan_payoff` when the balance amortizes down under a fixed payment. The response includes `chart_hints` with rendering directives any client can use.

annual_rate_pct.description: Annual interest rate as a percentage, e.g. 7 not 0.07. Decimal from 0 to 100. REQUIRED, no default.

apply_default_inflation.description: When true and inflation_rate_pct is 0, auto-selects inflation via MacroeconomicDefaults.ForHorizon. Ignored when inflation_rate_pct is greater than 0 or rate_convention is 'real'. Optional; defaults to false when omitted.

chart_title.description: Override for the chart title. Must not contain em-dashes or en-dashes. Max 120 characters. Optional.

compounds_per_year.description: Compounding periods per year. Integer, greater than 0. Optional; defaults to 12 when omitted.

inflation_rate_pct.description: Inflation rate as a percentage. Decimal: -1 (deprecated suppress, same as 0), 0 (no real-value overlay), or greater than 0 and less than 100 (explicit percentage, e.g. 3.5). Optional; defaults to 0 when omitted.

monthly_contribution.description: Additional contribution added each month. Decimal, at least 0. Optional; defaults to 0 when omitted.

principal.description: Starting balance. Decimal, at least 0. REQUIRED, no default.

rate_convention.description: 'nominal' or 'real'. 'real' unconditionally suppresses the inflation overlay; use when annual_rate_pct is already inflation-adjusted. Optional; defaults to 'nominal' when omitted.

years.description: Time horizon in years. Integer, at least 1. REQUIRED, no default.

name: calculate_compound_interest
title: Compound Interest Calculator
